title: Can Vision Models Read the Radar Display? On the Feasibility of Radar Imagery for Air Traffic Complexity Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Air traffic controllers perceive traffic complexity through the radar display, suggesting that a computer vision model operating on the same imagery may provide a natural architecture for modeling controller-perceived complexity; however, whether radar imagery is a viable input format for deep learning vision models remains unclear. Unlike natural images, radar images are extremely sparse and self-similar, consisting primarily of a black background and a few visually identical aircraft blobs, while small changes in aircraft positions can substantially alter sector-level complexity. To test whether a vision model can capture these operationally important differences, we encode each traffic situation as a position image supplemented by five channels representing aircraft state variables, including heading, speed, and altitude, and train a Vision Transformer (ViT) to regress four intrinsic complexity components derived from pairwise geome

translated_title: 视觉模型能读懂雷达显示屏吗？——关于雷达图像用于空中交通复杂性估计的可行性研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11810v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：空中交通管制员通过雷达显示屏感知交通复杂性，这表明基于相同图像运行的计算机视觉模型可能为建模管制员感知的复杂性提供一种自然的架构；然而，雷达图像作为深度学习视觉模型的可行输入格式仍不明确。与自然图像不同，雷达图像极其稀疏且高度自相似，主要由黑色背景和少数视觉上相同的飞机斑点组成，而飞机位置的微小变化可能显著改变扇区级别的复杂性。为测试视觉模型能否捕捉这些运行上重要的差异，我们将每个交通情景编码为一个位置图像，并辅以五个通道表示飞机状态变量（包括航向、速度和高度），然后训练一个视觉变换器（ViT）来回归从成对几何关系中导出的四个内在复杂性分量。
tldr: 本文探索了利用雷达图像作为视觉变换器输入来估计空中交通复杂性的可行性，通过编码飞机状态信息验证了深度学习模型能捕捉稀疏雷达图像中运行相关的复杂性变化。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the feasibility of using radar imagery as input to a Vision Transformer for air traffic complexity estimation, demonstrating that deep learning models can capture operationally relevant complexity variations in sparse radar images by encoding aircraft state information.
